title: Eye crop extraction pipeline with OpenCV Haar cascades
description: Implement detection/eye_extractor.py to detect face and eye regions using OpenCV Haar cascades, extract normalized eye crops (resize, color space conversion, float scaling), and report eye bounding box metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Loads OpenCV Haar cascade classifiers for face and eyes safely
Extracts left and right eye bounding boxes from input frame
Normalizes crops into specified CNN target dimension (e.g. 96x96, RGB float32)
Gracefully handles frames with zero or partial eyes detected, marking detection as unavailable
Unit tests verify crop extraction dimensions and edge cases on sample test images

steps.details: Create detection/eye_extractor.py with EyeExtractor class loading haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml and haarcascade_eye_tree_eyeglasses.xml.

steps.description: Implement eye detection and region filtering
steps.details: Implement detect_eyes(frame) searching face ROI first, then detecting upper-half eye regions to minimize false detections (e.g., nostrils or mouth).
Implement prepare_crops(crops, target_size=(96,96)) converting BGR to RGB, resizing with cv2.INTER_AREA, and returning float32 arrays.
Create tests/test_eye_extractor.py using synthetic images with drawn shapes or test frames to verify bounding boxes and array outputs.

technicalNotes: Preserve exact preprocessing between training and inference (target size 96x96, RGB channel order).
When eyes are not detected, return empty crop list rather than raising an unhandled exception.
